text:
alyssa: CI image push failing on linux-build-2 after my Dockerfile change, blocking e2e. job: https://ci.internal/12345
alyssa: error from registry: "blob upload not found" and `500 manifest upload failed` in logs
alyssa: snippet:
```
Step 12/14 : COPY --from=builder /app/dist /app/dist
 ---> Using cache
 ---> f2d3b1c
Pushing to registry internal-registry.redwood/company/service:pr-847
error: failed to upload blob: server responded with status 500
manifest push failed: unexpected status: 500
```
jonah: ugh, saw similar on monday. can you rerun the job first? sometimes transient on that node. @devops-bot can you kick a rerun for 12345? :eyes:
devops-bot: Rerun triggered for job 12345 by jonah — queued on linux-build-5
priya: can you try rebuilding with `--no-cache` locally or in a debug job? if that succeeds it's probably cache corruption on the builder/registry side
alyssa: ran local build with `docker build --no-cache -t local:test .` then pushed to an alternate registry and it succeeded (no 500). so build artifacts look fine.
jonah: ok that points to registry or build cache. @marta can you check registry health and disk usage for harbor cluster? also check token rotations for the CI service account.
marta: looking now — registry health ok, disk 72% used, no node restarts. I see a bunch of unfinished blob uploads around the time of the failure, and GC hasn't run in 36h. also noticed CI uses long-lived upload sessions that sometimes race with cache invalidation.
priya: two quick triage steps: 1) try pushing with `--disable-content-trust` (if using Docker content trust) or with a different tag; 2) reproduce on a clean builder with no cache. if both work, safe to assume corrupted cached layer on harbor.
alyssa: created debug job with `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --no-cache --progress=plain` and push to staging-registry, it passed. for PR pipeline I'll add a temporary `--no-cache` run while we root-cause.
jonah: can someone file a short bisect? suspect commit range 7b9..a1c changed multi-stage COPY semantics. if we revert the last change and CI passes, great.
priya: filing ticket with harbor support and also adding a cleanup step to the CI that runs `registry garbage-collect` nightly; pushing a tiny PR to add `--no-cache` on the flaky job now. cc @alyssa for confirmation
alyssa: thanks — small PR up: https://git.internal/p/842. will monitor after PR merge. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Job 12345 rerun completed on linux-build-5 — success
jonah: nice. follow-up: add a note to the infra runbook about when to suspect registry blob corruption (how-to clear caches, how to force new layer ids). should we add that now?
